arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Sutter argued the FMLA guarantees more than twelve weeks of absence.
He stated the law ensures a specific bundle of statutory rights.
Mr. Sutter claimed the company never offered intermittent work options.
He noted the company form only asked about sick leave needs.
